scope: Finite release qualification of GNU-compatible native Rust find grammar; complete option inventory delegates unsupported behavior before output. No universal speed or correctness claim.
oracle: /usr/bin/find, argv0=find, exact exit status, stdout bytes/order and stderr bytes; side-effect assertions use owned fixtures only
platform: Linux, unprivileged user, installed GNU find, fd, test-only strace and GNU C compiler/libdl
routeEvidence: Opt-in read-only --find2fd-route-json classification is separate from ordinary result comparison. Special stdout transports receive no native execution credit.

regressions.contract: A closed-reader stdout pipe with inherited SIGPIPE ignored must reproduce GNU status1 and complete Broken pipe diagnostics, rather than terminate with SIGPIPE.
regressions.redResult: GNU1 versus Rust141; exact GNU argv0=find

regressions.contract: A tiny print0 result into an already full nonblocking stdout pipe with the reader kept alive must preserve GNU status1 and complete EAGAIN diagnostics; final buffer-flush errors cannot become success.
regressions.redResult: GNU1 versus Rust0; exact GNU argv0=find

regressions.contract: For -name matching, GNU removes all trailing root slashes while preserving the original raw root spelling in print output; this is different from the GNU printf %f directive.
regressions.redResult: GNU prints tree/ NUL for tree/ -maxdepth0 -name tree -print0; Rust printed nothing

regressions.contract: Under -P, a child directory replaced with an outside symlink immediately before opening must not expose any outside marker; after preparation rejects that swap, untouched GNU execution must exactly match the settled post-swap tree without partial native replay.
regressions.faultInjection: Owned fixture LD_PRELOAD openat/opendir interception; no production paths
regressions.mutationControl: Removing only O_NOFOLLOW at the controlled child leaks the sentinel and violates the tested invariant; the native negative control matches GNU without mutation.
regressions.coverageLimit: Proves this deterministic child replacement and the unchanged fixture; not every possible filesystem mutation or temporal snapshot equivalence

optimizationContracts.contract: Literal, all-star, prefix, suffix and contains specializations preserve GNU byte matching, empty patterns, repeated stars, ASCII case folding, nonASCII and raw newline/invalidUTF8 names.
Maxdepth0 or1 retains exact GNU output and does not create a worker pool when no descending work remains.

Owned getdents64 injection forces DT_UNKNOWN and actual anchored fstatat resolution, preserves complete raw GNU order across32KiB batches, and delegates malformed length/NUL/header records before stdout.
An owned deleted entry retained in a raw batch with inode0 is skipped natively, with output identical to GNU on the settled tree and external exec proof that no GNU fallback masked the behavior.
